title: more gunpowder (creeper)
description: A simple vanilla datapack that increases Creeper Gunpowder drops. Perfect for players who want more Gunpowder without changing other gameplay mechanics.
body:
More Creeper Gunpowder is a simple vanilla datapack that increases the amount of Gunpowder dropped by Creepers. It is designed for players who want an easier way to collect Gunpowder without adding new items, changing recipes, or installing mods.

Gunpowder is one of the most useful resources in Minecraft. It is required for crafting TNT, Firework Rockets, and Firework Stars. If you enjoy building with TNT, using Elytra for long-distance travel, or creating large firework displays, collecting enough Gunpowder can become time-consuming. This datapack helps reduce that grind by increasing Creeper drops while keeping the rest of the game unchanged.

The datapack is lightweight and fully vanilla, meaning it works without any mod loader. Simply install it in your world's datapacks folder, reload your world, and you're ready to go. It is also multiplayer-friendly, as only the server or world needs to have the datapack installed.
